plugins.name: klipper-motion
plugins.title: Smoother Motion
plugins.description:
Brings your printer's motion engine up to date with the newest Klipper improvements, so prints come out cleaner with nothing to set up.

What you get:
• Less ghosting and ringing: smarter resonance measurement plus a gentle new 'sweeping vibrations' test make input-shaper calibration more accurate, so the faint echo lines after sharp edges shrink.
• Smoother corners: improved cornering math keeps fast moves accurate and a little quieter.
• Snappier moves: the motion planner reacts a touch faster, trimming small stutters on detailed models.

What you'll notice: cleaner surfaces, fewer ghost marks, and smoother, quieter movement. It just updates the engine under the hood. Advanced users can re-run input-shaper calibration to get the most out of it.

Under the hood this updates Klipper's own program files on the printer. Uninstalling puts the originals back, and it re-applies itself automatically after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
plugins.tagline: Cleaner surfaces and quieter moves, from the latest Klipper motion code.
plugins.author: bespoked

plugins.name: tmc-autotune
plugins.title: TMC Auto-Tuned
plugins.description: Applies optimized TMC2240 driver settings (StealthChop tuning, CoolStep, hysteresis) to the X and Y steppers, from Argolein's SnapmakerU1 custom config. These modify low-level driver registers, so monitor motor temperatures on first use. Works only on the Snapmaker U1.
plugins.tagline: Argolein's optimized TMC2240 driver parameters for X/Y.
plugins.author: bespoked

plugins.name: tmc-low-current
plugins.title: TMC Low Current
plugins.description: Lowers the X and Y TMC2240 run current from 1.2 to 1.0 A for less heat and quieter motion. May skip steps under heavy load or fast moves; watch for layer shifts and raise the current again if motion suffers. Works only on the Snapmaker U1.
plugins.tagline: Cooler, quieter X/Y motion at reduced stepper current.
plugins.author: bespoked

collections.name: performance-pack
collections.title: Performance Pack
collections.description:
Quieter, cooler X/Y motion and a purge line that is out of your way, in one install. TMC Auto-Tuned applies Argolein's optimized TMC2240 driver settings to the X and Y steppers, TMC Low Current drops their run current from 1.2 to 1.0 A for less heat and less noise, and Purge Line at Back moves the start-of-print purge line from the front of the plate to the back, clear of the part. The two driver changes touch different settings, so they work together.

These are low-level driver changes: watch the motor temperatures on the first print, and if you see a layer shift on a fast or heavy move, remove TMC Low Current and the stock current comes back. Snapmaker U1 only.
collections.tagline: Quieter, cooler X/Y motion and a purge line out of your way.
collections.author: bespoked
